name: What is AKN Design Group's approach to appliance installation during a kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is AKN Design Group's approach to appliance installation during a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: During a kitchen remodel, AKN Design Group integrates appliance installation seamlessly into the overall project plan. We consider the specific requirements for each appliance—such as electrical needs, gas lines, water connections, and ventilation—early in the design phase. This ensures that the custom cabinetry, countertops, and utility hookups are precisely prepared to accommodate your chosen appliances, from high-end ranges and built-in refrigerators to dishwashers and microwave drawers. Our managed process guarantees that all installations align with the aesthetic and functional vision for your new kitchen, avoiding common issues that arise from uncoordinated installations. This comprehensive approach is part of our commitment to a single point of coordination for complex renovations.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group integrates appliance installation into the kitchen remodel design phase, ensuring proper utility hookups and seamless integration with custom cabinetry and countertops.
